criteria.criterion: Record series metadata exactly as displayed (units, frequency, seasonal adjustment)
criteria.description: Report the UNRATE series metadata fields: Units, Frequency, and Seasonal Adjustment, preserving the wording exactly as displayed on the UNRATE page. Full credit if all three are captured verbatim from the visible page. Partial credit if one field is missing or wording is paraphrased. If the UNRATE page cannot be accessed/loaded to view metadata, award full credit here only if the agent explicitly states that the metadata could not be viewed due to the access issue (do not award credit if the agent guesses/hallucinates).

Increase from baseline partial to near-full but not perfect verbatim.
